L31: ### SPU EVENTS
L32: ### THE UNIVERSITY LIBRARY
L33: 
L34: Welcome to the heart of academic life at St. Paul's University. Our library is more than just a collection of books; it is a dynamic and supportive hub for learning, research, and collaboration. We are dedicated to providing the comprehensive resources, expert guidance, and modern facilities you need to excel in your studies and scholarly pursuits.

L75: 【33†Mission & Vision】
L76: ### LIBRARY SERVICES FOR YOUR SUCCESS
L77: 
L78: Our professional library staff are here to provide the support and training you need to thrive academically.
L79: 
L80: RESEARCH SUPPORT
L81: 
L82: Our subject librarians are available for one-on-one consultations to help you develop research strategies, navigate complex databases, and find the exact information you need for your assignments.
L83: 
L84: INFORMATION LITERACY TRAINING
L85: We regularly host workshops designed to enhance your academic skills. Popular topics include advanced search techniques, proper citation and referencing  and avoiding plagiarism.
L86: 
L87: BORROWING & CIRCULATION
L88: 
L89: We also offer inter-library loan services to source materials from partner institutions when needed.
L90: 
L91: FACILITIES & TECHNOLOGY
L92: The library offers a variety of modern facilities, including: Quiet individual study carrels, collaborative group study rooms, fully equipped computer labs with high-speed internet, printing, scanning, and photocopying services.
L93: 
L94: 【34†Image】
L95: ### Extensive Physical Collection
L96: 
L97: Our shelves house a carefully curated collection of materials supporting all university curricula, including:
L98: 
L99:   * Core Textbooks & Reference Materials: Essential reading for all courses offered at SPU.
L100: 
L101:   * Academic Journals & Periodicals: Stay current with the latest research and discourse in your field.
L102:   * Special Collections: Unique and valuable resources, including theological texts and historical university publications.
